metadata.title: Soft-Focus Nostalgic Portrait with Linear Overlays

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman with short blonde hair, set against a white background featuring faint horizontal blue lines resembling musical staff paper. The composition is accented by a vintage pocket watch face on the right and a small steam train silhouette on the lower left, all tied together with elegant, flowing script at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered between symbolic icons of time and travel
Horizontal blue lines providing a rhythmic grid for the composition
Warm skin tones contrasting against a cool, sterile white and blue background
Flowing script mirroring the curves of the subject's hair and clothing

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up, centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the top third intersection.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the script, down to the train silhouette on the left, across to the watch on the right, and back to the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space around the subject, structured by the horizontal lines.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background and white blouse providing a high-key base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Faint cyan/blue for the horizontal lines and script.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm peach and golden tones in the subject's hair and skin.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high brightness; the only dark value is the small train silhouette.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid harsh blacks except for small icons
Limit to white, cyan, and warm skin tones

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick downstrokes and hair-line upstrokes
Elongated, flourishing swashes on initial and terminal characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders extend horizontally to frame the top edge
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single script face paired with minimal graphic icons.

preserve: The blue color of the text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the elegant, high-contrast flourishing style.
Offers similar formal elegance and long swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a woman with 1980s feathered blonde hair wearing a white blouse, centered on a white background with faint horizontal blue notebook lines. Include a small vintage pocket watch face on the right and a tiny black steam train silhouette on the bottom left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom flowing script across the top in a dark blue color, featuring long horizontal flourishes that span the width of the image.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal lines faint and blue?
Is the lighting soft and flattering?
Does the script have elegant, elongated swashes?
Are the icons (watch and train) small and peripheral?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject
Any specific brand logos on the watch face
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text color matches the line color.
Verify the train silhouette is solid black.
Check that the watch face is cropped or integrated smoothly into the lines.
Confirm the portrait has a nostalgic, slightly hazy quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + horizontal ruling lines + symbolic silhouettes + elegant script header.
